alfred_standup_summary: Alfred is documented as operational enough to receive, summarize, prepare, and route supplied WP-0617-compatible resident/background-operation requests while stating live-access limits.
alfred_wp0617_integration_summary: WP-0617 is explicitly the background operations runtime owner; Alfred does not own a competing event loop, resident feed, watch daemon, dispatch queue, or status system.
helen_package_summary: Helen now has a minimum viable profile, validation prompts, TextGen 4.9 export placeholder, and runtime integration document with authority, protected-source, no-impersonation, connector-honesty, and office-routing boundaries.
helen_wp0617_integration_summary: Helen may consume, summarize, or prepare governed WP-0617-compatible requests for workforce allocation and worker-health visibility but must not execute providers, assign workers directly, or run watches/queues.
qmaster_return_gate_summary: The return gate records that resident work exists to support Estate execution and Qmaster progress, defines what is required and not required before return, and points transition awareness through WP-0617 rather than a resident runtime.
known_limitations: No live TextGen, Ollama, Open WebUI, SillyTavern, repository watcher, mailbox, or worker queue smoke tests were performed.
Helen remains a minimum viable resident package, not a full production runtime.
Resident operation examples are deterministic fixtures, not a WP-0617 evaluator implementation.
recommended_next_action: Run or implement WP-0617 so background operations can carry Alfred/Helen resident task awareness while the Steward returns to Qmaster.
